_comment: Garmin Dash Cam Live trips in rental vehicles. Maintained manually — after each rental, review clips in the Garmin Drive app, then add an entry below. The dashboard reads this file as-is.
_format: Each trip: { id, date (YYYY-MM-DD), driver_id (optional roster slot like 'd4') OR driver_name (free-text for non-roster), vehicle, mileage (number), incidents (count), notes }

_example.notes: One hard-brake event near downtown intersection; clip reviewed in Garmin Vault — OK, no follow-up needed.
